# lumos_workflow_steps (Data Source)

WorkflowSteps DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_workflow_steps" "my_workflowsteps" {
  app_id     = "...my_app_id..."
  page_size  = 100
  page_token = "...my_page_token..."
  search     = "...my_search..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The app to list steps for.

### Optional

- `page_size` (Number) Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 1000 are clamped to 1000 rather than rejected.
- `page_token` (String) Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive substring filter over step names.

### Read-Only

- `next_page_token` (String) Token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. An absent token is the only end-of-results signal. A page holding fewer than `page_size` items does not mean the results are exhausted. Treat the value as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `workflow_steps` (Attributes List) Workflow step templates returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflow_steps))

<a id="nestedatt--workflow_steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workflow_steps`

Read-Only:

- `input_schema` (Attributes Map) The input schema for the step, describing available inputs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflow_steps--input_schema))
- `name` (String) A human-readable name for this step.
- `step` (String) Identifier (catalogue slug) for the step.

<a id="nestedatt--workflow_steps--input_schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workflow_steps.input_schema`

Read-Only:

- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the parameter should be hidden.
- `label` (String) A human-readable label for the parameter.
- `options` (List of String) Available options for the value of this field.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the parameter is required.
- `type` (String) The type of the parameter.
